papers_read.title_as_printed: Predicting Mild Cognitive Impairment in Type 2 Diabetes: A Machine Learning Approach (Li et al., Journal of Diabetes Research 2025, Article ID 7304414)
Explainable machine learning models for identifying mild cognitive impairment in older patients with chronic pain (Zhang et al., BMC Nursing 2025;24:72)

what_each_reports.P-343: SVC on seven routine variables (age, education, eGFR, SBP, BMI, T2DM duration, GCA glucolipid index) for clinically diagnosed MCI in 2074 T2DM inpatients: internal cross-validated AUC 0.74 +/- 0.04 (extract '0 74 ± 0 04', decimal points dropped; decoded from the paper's tables), external DECODE AUC 0.80.
what_each_reports.P-307: XGBoost on seven variables (age, education, pain duration, pain sites, VAS pain level, GDS-15, PSQI) for MCI in 612 chronic-pain patients aged >= 60: test-set AUC 0.925 (95% CI 0.863-0.995), internal random 30% split after SMOTETomek balancing of the training set.

quantity_a: ROC-AUC of a routine-clinical-variable SVC for clinically diagnosed MCI vs normal cognition in hospitalised Chinese T2DM patients aged >= 40 (quoted 0.80 = external DECODE figure).
quantity_b: ROC-AUC of an XGBoost model on pain, depression, sleep and demographic variables for MCI vs non-MCI in Chinese chronic-pain patients aged >= 60 (internal test split).
incompatible_if_same: No ordering claimed by either paper is refuted by the other. The figures also come from unlike validation splits (an external cohort for P-343, an internal random split for P-307), which usually lowers the external figure.

gates.task: match in the broad sense (cross-sectional MCI detection, T1).
gates.dataset_family: mismatch: Nanjing Drum Tower T2DM inpatients vs a Nanchang pain-department cohort; the record's dataset_equal 'Yes' is wrong; no waiver on record.
gates.validation_tier: mismatch: the compared P-343 figure is an external-cohort AUC; P-307's is an internal random-split AUC (V2).
gates.modality_family: match in family (clinical/tabular) but predictor sets disjoint apart from age and education. The record's 'P-307=retinal' is wrong.

endpoint_and_metric: incompatible: same metric type (ROC-AUC) but different populations behind the MCI label (T2DM inpatients vs chronic-pain patients), different predictor sets, and different validation settings (external vs internal).
performance_validity: flag does not apply: 0.925 and 0.80 are below 0.97.
independence: Independent: different authors, institutions and cohorts.
grounds: The populations behind the shared MCI label differ: hospitalised T2DM patients in P-343 against older chronic-pain patients in P-307.
The predictor sets differ (renal, blood-pressure and glucolipid variables vs pain, depression and sleep scales), so the two AUCs describe different models.
The dataset-family and validation-tier gates both fail (unrelated cohorts; an external AUC against an internal-split AUC), and no waiver is recorded.
Neither paper makes a claim about the other's model or population.

evidence_quotes.quote: External validation with the DECODE cohort yielded an AUC of 0.80, an F1 score of 0.80, and a recall of 0.89.
Ultimately, variables including age, education, eGFR, SBP, BMI, T2DM duration, and the previously derived representation index were incorporated into model development.
A total of 612 older patients with chronic pain were recruited between October 2023 and July 2024.
the final selected variables were: age, education level, pain duration, number of pain sites, pain level, depression, sleep quality
the XGBoost model performed best, achieving an accuracy of 0.883 and an AUC of 0.925 (95% CI 0.863–0.995).

record_defects: resolution_note states 'Modality mismatch: P-343=clinical_survey vs P-307=retinal'; P-307 uses no retinal or imaging data.
dataset_equal is 'Yes'; the two studies use unrelated hospital cohorts in different cities and populations.
resolution 'Rejected - false positive' coexists with resolution_status partially_resolved_candidate, and no named third study showing a separating condition is recorded.
claim_a's 'AUC 0.80' is P-343's external figure; its internal AUC is 0.74 +/- 0.04.
Registry P-343: Sample_N_Approx '074' (paper: 2074), Dataset 'NHANES', Validation_Type 'not reported' (external validation performed).
what_would_change_the_verdict: A common evaluation of both models in one population with one MCI definition; neither paper provides it.
